item.title: Version 1.13.3
item.description:
Today's P&L, done right

  • Lots bought today count from your buy price. Today's P&L used to count the whole move since yesterday's close, even for shares bought mid-session; now it starts from what you paid. Thanks to Mo (@hamidi-dev).
  • Purchase date starts empty. New lots no longer default to today, so a position held for years doesn't show its whole gain as today's P&L. Pick a day or leave it "Not set", and clear it any time.
  • Sort the watchlist by Trend and 52-week. Trend sorts by the change over the selected range, 52-week by where the price sits in its yearly range.
  • Overview chart color fixed. The portfolio curve is green or red by the period's gain, no longer turning green just because you bought more.
